subject: Banking
title: The LIBOR Scandal
description: A short lesson to help you apply The LIBOR Scandal.

hook.text: LIBOR set interest rates for $350 trillion in financial products.

buildup.text: LIBOR was calculated from self-reported borrowing rates from major banks. No one verified the numbers.

discovery.text: Traders at Barclays, UBS, and Deutsche Bank colluded to manipulate LIBOR.

twist.text: During the 2008 crisis, banks reported artificially low LIBOR to appear healthier.

climax.text: LIBOR fraud affected every mortgage, student loan, and credit card on Earth.

punchline.text: $350 trillion affected. Banks rigged the most trusted rate. LIBOR was a lie.

quiz.question: How much in financial products was affected by LIBOR manipulation?

details.summary: Banks colluded to manipulate LIBOR, the London Interbank Offered Rate that set interest rates on $350 trillion in financial products worldwide, rigging the benchmark for profit while regulators looked the other way.
details.whyItMatters: LIBOR touched nearly every financial product on earth, from mortgages to derivatives. Its manipulation meant that billions of people unknowingly paid distorted interest rates set by colluding bankers.
takeaways: LIBOR was based on self-reported rates from 16 banks, inviting manipulation
Banks paid over $9 billion in combined fines for LIBOR rigging
LIBOR was officially replaced by alternative rates like SOFR in 2023

faq.question: How was LIBOR manipulated?
faq.answer: Banks submitted false borrowing rates to benefit their derivative trading positions. Traders at different banks coordinated via chat and email to move the rate in directions that boosted their portfolios.

faq.question: Why was LIBOR replaced?
faq.answer: The manipulation scandal and the fact that LIBOR was based on estimates rather than actual transactions made it unreliable. SOFR, the Secured Overnight Financing Rate, is based on real overnight lending data and is harder to manipulate.
